يعتطفون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَطِفُونَ (yaʕtaṭifūna) /jaʕ.ta.tˤi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# يُعْتَطَفُونَ (yuʕtaṭafūna) /juʕ.ta.tˤa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
